page.title: Scheduled triggers
page.description: Scheduled triggers derived from published graphs. Each graph yields two rows: Run and Reflect (reflection only proposes, never edits the graph). Scheduling always runs the pinned published version; editing the draft has no effect until republished.
page.utcNotice: Cron is evaluated in UTC by default; when an IANA timezone is configured, it is evaluated against that timezone's wall-clock time. Claiming and display remain UTC (Beijing time = UTC+8). Missed slots are never replayed by default; only an explicit catch-up window (catch_up_minutes) replays unclaimed slots.
page.empty: No schedules yet: add a Schedule (Cron) trigger node to a graph and publish it to see both rows (Run and Reflect).

actions.running: Started a run pinned to v{{version}} (does not consume the scheduled slot)
actions.reflected: Ran a reflection pass ({{status}}; proposals only, no slot consumed)

cron.hint: 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday, evaluated in the selected timezone's wall-clock time. Supports * , */n, a-b, a-b/n and comma lists; 7 means Sunday.
cron.tzHint: IANA timezone name (e.g. Asia/Shanghai). Leave empty or UTC to evaluate in UTC.
cron.unavailable: Preview unavailable (network or session issue); validation on save is authoritative.
